subject.title: fix(sessions_send): omit misleading delivery.status from async A2A responses (#96020)

question: Should async sessions_send A2A responses omit delivery metadata, or should OpenClaw define explicit async delivery.status values for those paths?
rationale: Both open candidate PRs fix the stale pending value but expose different user-visible response semantics, and automation cannot decide the permanent sessions_send contract for downstream tool consumers.

options.title: Accept omitted async delivery metadata
options.body: Land this PR's contract after real sessions_send proof and current-main merge refresh, preserving skipped metadata only for skipped A2A.

options.title: Choose explicit status values
options.body: Use the sibling contract only if maintainers define what sent, delivered, and accepted mean despite async announce delivery completing later.

options.title: Pause both candidate PRs
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers design a queryable delivery-id or callback-based contract instead of changing the response shape now.

recommendation.title: Accept omitted async delivery metadata
recommendation.body: Land this PR's contract after real sessions_send proof and current-main merge refresh, preserving skipped metadata only for skipped A2A.

likelyOwner.reason: The current and historical delivery-semantics history most directly routes the response-contract decision through this person.
